conditions: Same-value donor null (same persona value, different carrier)
Cross-type donor null (non-persona information type, construct-screened)
Rung R1: named persona with pervasive dialect (Captain Marrow, pirate)
Rung R2: named persona with episodic markers (Reginald, butler)
Rung R3: unnamed register (warm, encouraging, informal)
Rung R5: situational user-persona, no style instruction (Lu et al. therapy persona)
Rung R5: situational user-persona, no style instruction (Lu et al. philosophy persona)
Joint all-boundary patch (tb: every assistant-turn end plus context-end)
Single-boundary patch at boundary k (per-boundary sweep)
Parent single context-end patch (reused reference rows)
metrics: activation fraction-of-swap (F_act, projection onto the pair's own contrast direction)
anchor separation (target descriptor, ceiling minus floor)
netted dual-rubric fraction-of-swap at the turn-boundary set (F_tb)
d1 identity gap (tb at depth 1 minus parent context-end F)
per-boundary steered minus shuffled-null F difference
realized patch mode per cell (realized_mode; expected constant replace_multi under the extended multi-position replace hook)

figures.title: Specificity ladder: steered vs both nulls per rung
figures.transform: per (direction x slot x arm x rung): pair value = mean F_target over K=5 coherent draws per carrier; rung mean over gate-surviving carriers; carrier-clustered bootstrap 95% CI (B=10000, seed 21626); panels install/erase, context-end primary with prefix-end companion; per-rung n and system-prompt token count annotated
figures.plotted_quantity: mean target-descriptor fraction-of-swap F_target (unitless; 0 = floor, 1 = full context swap)

figures.title: Specificity ladder - per-carrier companion
figures.transform: same exclusions as ladder_hero, NO aggregation: one point per gate-surviving (carrier x arm x rung x direction x slot), carrier-labeled, arm-offset

figures.title: Erase vs install asymmetry per rung
figures.transform: per (rung x slot): paired-by-carrier steered erase F_target minus install F_target; per-carrier points plus mean with carrier-clustered bootstrap 95% CI (B=10000, seed 21626)
figures.plotted_quantity: paired erase-minus-install difference in F_target (unitless; positive = erasure easier)

figures.title: Anchor separations and gate verdicts per rung
figures.transform: per (rung x carrier) from K=10 anchor draws: target-descriptor separation (ceiling minus floor, 0-1 scale) against the 0.25 bar, and netted dual-rubric separation against the 0.5 bar; pass/fail verdicts marked; ALL rungs rendered including gate failures
figures.plotted_quantity: anchor separation per carrier (target-descriptor scale 0-1; netted scale 0-2)

figures.title: Netted dual-rubric F vs target-only F (rubric-artifact quantification)
figures.transform: per (direction x slot x arm): scatter of netted dual-rubric F (parent metric, x) vs F_target (this round's primary, y), arms color-coded; identity line drawn; quantifies the anti-source-channel inflation measured in Round A (null 0.479 netted vs <=0.003 target-only)
figures.plotted_quantity: F under the two metric conventions (unitless)

figures.title: Continuous-companion agreement: F_act vs F_target and margin validation
figures.transform: panel 1: per (direction x slot x arm) scatter of F_act (y) vs F_target (x) with Spearman rho annotated; panel 2: margin shift vs F_target across cells with dynamic range, Spearman rho (the pre-registered margin validation); panel 3: coherence rate and cap-hit fraction per cell
figures.plotted_quantity: F_act (signed projection, unitless), TF margin shift (nats/token), coherence rate (0-1)

figures.title: Per-conjunct decomposition on R1/R2 steered installs
figures.transform: R1/R2 STEERED rollouts only: mean per-conjunct descriptor score (Round-A conjunct instrument verbatim) beside the holistic target-descriptor score, per direction x slot

figures.title: Joint turn-boundary patch vs single context-end across depth
figures.transform: per (cell x arm): pair value = mean F over K=5 coherent draws (registered space: netted dual-rubric for instruction-format cells + control, target-descriptor-only for persona cells); cell mean over surviving pairs (|separation| >= 0.5, reused parent anchors); pair-clustered bootstrap 95% CI (B=10000, seed 21620); overlay = parent single-ce steered cell means (instruction-format cells + control from f_cells.jsonl; persona-cell overlay points RE-AGGREGATED into the target-descriptor-only space from the parent's per-rubric judge scores); per-pair points behind each bar
figures.plotted_quantity: mean fraction-of-swap F at the joint turn-boundary set (unitless; 0 = unpatched floor, 1 = full context swap), per base x depth x arm

figures.title: Per-boundary localization sweep (steered minus shuffled null)
figures.transform: per single-boundary variant k: per-pair paired difference (steered F minus shuffled-null F), mean over surviving pairs, pair-clustered bootstrap 95% CI (B=10000); x = boundary index k (earliest assistant turn .. final); the final-boundary point is the PARENT ce read (parent-run provenance labeled; persona-cell points re-aggregated into the target-descriptor-only space)
figures.plotted_quantity: mean steered-minus-null F difference per boundary index k, per base x depth

figures.title: Raw-scale (un-normalized) movement at the turn-boundary set
figures.transform: per (cell x arm): mean signed raw movement (delta_patched - delta_floor) * sign(delta_ceiling - delta_floor) in judge-contrast units, over `all` AND `surviving` pair sets; bootstrap 95% CI (B=10000, seed 21620); companion panel = parent single-ce raw movement from recency_rawscale.json
figures.plotted_quantity: signed raw behavioral movement in judge-contrast units (range [-2, +2]), per base x depth x arm

figures.title: Depth-1 identity gate: tb reproduces the parent context-end read
figures.transform: per pair (both d1 cells, steered + shuffled arms): scatter of this round's tb@d1 pair F (netted space) vs the parent ce pair F; identity diagonal + the +/-0.10 gate band; the gate statistic (mean delta + pair-clustered bootstrap CI, annotated from identity_gate.json) is pooled over SURVIVING pairs only (66/arm: instr_format 36/36 + persona 30/36 at |separation| >= 0.5); non-surviving pairs shown greyed, excluded from the gate statistic
figures.plotted_quantity: per-pair F at tb depth-1 vs parent context-end F (unitless)

figures.title: Near-zero control under the joint turn-boundary patch
figures.transform: control cell (user-name fact, depth 5): per-arm mean F over surviving pairs + pair-clustered bootstrap 95% CI (B=10000); per-pair points; the edit-artifact overlay verdict annotated
figures.plotted_quantity: mean F per arm at the control cell (expected ~0 in every arm)

figures.title: Persona cells: target-descriptor-only vs netted dual-rubric read
figures.transform: persona cells only, joint tb blocks: per-arm cell means computed BOTH ways from the same judge calls - netted dual-rubric F and target-descriptor-only F - over surviving pairs; pair-clustered bootstrap 95% CIs; side-by-side per depth
figures.plotted_quantity: mean F per arm x depth under the two aggregation spaces (unitless)

replaces_parent_manifest_for_round_figur: persona-specificity-ladder figures only (figures[0:7]); the turn-boundary-multipatch figures (tb_*) APPEND to the parent manifest and replace nothing
